title: Practice: Present perfect progressive: I have been writing

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **идти → идет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: It has been raining since Tuesday.

exercises.why: **жить → живём** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: We've been living here since July.
I've been sitting here all night.

exercises.why: **работать → работают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: They've been working on a new vaccine.

exercises.why: **вести → ведёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: Tom has been behaving like a kindergarten kid.

exercises.why: **заниматься → занимается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: Jacques has been doing judo for two years.
I have been learning Russian since November.

exercises.why: **расти → растут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Моя дочь уже четыре года ___ (страдать) анорексией.
exercises.why: **страдать → страдает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: My daughter has been suffering from anorexia for four years already.
